about.title: About Nebulis
about.story1: I've always loved astronomy and astrophotography. In 2023 I bought a Seestar, and quickly ran into a wall: getting images off the device and organized was a slog of manual file copying and guesswork. I wrote a few scripts to handle it for myself, and those scripts kept growing until they turned into a full app.
about.story2: Nebulis is that app. It does the tedious part, pulling images off your telescope, organizing them, and matching them against catalogs, so you can spend more time observing and less time managing files.
about.feedbackBefore: Found a bug, or have an idea for a feature? Email
about.supportDescription: Nebulis is free and built in my spare time. If it's useful to you, a coffee is always appreciated.

addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutTitle: Generic SMB Layout: folder format the import expects
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutIntro: For non-SeeStar / non-Dwarf shares, organize your files like this on the SMB share root:
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule1: = catalog id (M31, NGC1788, IC1805) or a common name (Andromeda, Heart). Catalog ids resolve to better metadata.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule2: = YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM in local time. The date drives the calendar view; the time disambiguates multiple sessions in one night.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule3: at least one stacked or single image (.fit / .fits / .jpg / .png).
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule4: used for quality scoring and per-frame review.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule5: JSON with exposureSec, gain, filter, frameCount, integrationSec. Anything missing is inferred from filenames or left blank.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule6: Filenames are flexible. Anything ending in a recognized extension under lights/ or subframes/ is picked up.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutFooter: The importer skips object folders with no lights/ subfolder, so partial uploads won't pollute your library.
addTelescopeModal.mergeBody: This device is already paired to your telescope {{name}}. Add this connection to it so files don't import twice.
addTelescopeModal.opticalConfigsHelp: No fixed field of view is known for this telescope. Add one entry per optical setup you actually use (for example "Native" and "0.8x Reducer") and pick which is mounted right now. The Framing & Mosaic preview uses whichever is active.

includeSubframes.label: Include subframes
includeSubframes.description: Subframes are the individual raw exposures. They are most of the size and most of the value of a backup.

minAge.label: Wait before archiving
minAge.description: New captures stay local until they reach this age, so anything you are still actively processing is not copied away yet. Use 0 to archive new captures as soon as a run finds them.

schedule.description: Copies anything new on a schedule, in the timezone of your observing site.
schedule.cronDescription: Five fields: minute, hour, day of the month, month, and day of the week. For example 0 3 * * * is every day at 03:00. A custom schedule runs at its exact minute and does not catch up if Nebulis was closed.
schedule.manualNote: Nothing runs on its own. Press Archive now when you want a copy.

retention.enabledDescription: Deletes old files from the archive disk as part of a run, but only files your library still has. If the library no longer has a file, its archived copy is kept. Your library is never touched.
retention.enableConfirm: Turn on pruning? Archived files past the period below will be deleted, but only if your library still has the same file. Your library is not touched.
retention.label: Delete from the archive after
retention.description: Measured from the last time each object was archived, so an object still being copied is never pruned. A file your library no longer has is never pruned.

removeLocal.label: Remove local subframes after archiving
removeLocal.description: Frees space on this machine once the archived copy is verified. Subframes are deleted from this local Nebulis library, not from the archive disk copy.
removeLocal.warning: This deletes subframes from your library permanently: from this local Nebulis instance, not from the archive disk. A subframe is only removed after its archived copy is verified by size and checksum, but if the archive disk is lost those frames are gone.

archive.removeLocalConfirm: Turn on permanent deletion of local subframes? They will be removed from this machine once their archived copy is verified.

archive.runCancelled: Cancelled. {{copied}} files were archived before it stopped.
archive.runFinishedLinked_one: {{count}} linked file is not included in the archive.
archive.runFinishedLinked_other: {{count}} linked files are not included in the archive.
archive.sameDiskWarning: This archive is on the same disk as your library, so it will not survive that disk failing. Use a separate disk for a real backup.
archive.pruneConfirm: Remove {{count}} files from the archive disk? This cannot be undone.
archive.nothingToPrune: Nothing is old enough to prune.

disk.name: Disk
disk.title: Choose the archive disk
disk.body: Pick a folder on the disk you plan to unplug. Choosing it here does not write anything to the disk.
disk.claimNote: Nebulis will claim this folder as your archive when you turn the archive on.

copy.name: What to copy
copy.title: What should be copied?
copy.body: Choose how much of your library goes to the disk.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.title: When should it run?
schedule.body: Choose whether copies happen on their own.

cleanup.name: Cleanup
cleanup.title: Delete anything afterward?
cleanup.body: Both options are off by default. Leave them off unless you want Nebulis to delete files.

review.name: Review
review.title: Ready to turn it on?
review.body: This is what the archive will do.
review.warning: Turning the archive on lets Nebulis write to this disk. Check that it is the disk you expect.

intro.title: Set up your archive
intro.body: Copy your library to a disk you can unplug. Setup takes five short steps, and nothing is copied or deleted until the last one.
intro.offBody: Your settings are saved. Nothing is copied or deleted while the archive is off.

archiveDisk.title: Archive disk
archiveDisk.subtitle: What is on the archive disk.
archiveDisk.filesSubtitle: Select files to copy back into the library.
archiveDisk.notInLibrary: Not in the library any more
archiveDisk.restoreFailed: The restore did not work. Try again.
archiveDisk.restoreNote: Restored files come back with their size, capture date and telescope. A night you moved to another date by hand is not remembered and goes back to the date in the file name.

archiveDestination.title: Choose the archive destination
archiveDestination.subtitle: A folder on a disk, or a shared folder on your network.
archiveDestination.noDrives: No drives found. Connect a USB or external drive and refresh.
archiveDestination.folderNameInvalid: A folder name cannot contain a slash.
archiveDestination.passwordHint: Leave empty for a share with no password.
archiveDestination.passwordKeepHint: A password is saved. Leave this empty to keep using it.
archiveDestination.testOk: Connected. Choose a folder below, or use the share as it is.
archiveDestination.testFailed: That test did not work. Try again.
archiveDestination.unsupported: Network shares are not supported on this platform. Mount the share on the host and choose the mounted folder under the Drive tab.

layoutMigration.title: Your library needs a one-time update
layoutMigration.intro: This version organizes your photos in a new way. Each night gets its own folder, and new imports keep the exact file names from your telescope. Your library was set up the older way, so it needs to be converted once.
layoutMigration.countInfo_one: {{count}} object in your library will be converted.
layoutMigration.countInfo_other: {{count}} objects in your library will be converted.
layoutMigration.pointMoved: Files are moved into new folders. Nothing is deleted.
layoutMigration.pointNames: Files already in your library keep their current names. Only future imports keep the original telescope names.
layoutMigration.pointWait: Syncs pause while this runs. Keep this window open and keep your library drive connected.
layoutMigration.doneTitle: Your library is up to date
layoutMigration.doneBody_one: {{count}} file was moved into the new layout.
layoutMigration.doneBody_other: {{count}} files were moved into the new layout.
layoutMigration.failedTitle: Some objects could not be converted
layoutMigration.failedBody_one: {{count}} object could not be converted. Nothing was lost, and it stays as it is. You will be asked again next time you open Nebulis.
layoutMigration.failedBody_other: {{count}} objects could not be converted. Nothing was lost, and they stay as they are. You will be asked again next time you open Nebulis.
layoutMigration.startFailed: The update could not start. Try again in a moment.

linkedFolders.title: Linked folders
linkedFolders.description: Folders indexed where they are, not copied.
linkedFolders.explanation: A linked folder stays on your disk or network share. Nebulis reads it in place so its objects show up in your library. Unlinking or rescanning only changes the index and never touches your files.
linkedFolders.offline: This folder cannot be reached right now. Nothing has been changed. Reconnect the drive or share and rescan.
linkedFolders.missingFiles_one: {{count}} file was not found on the last scan. It is kept until a second scan confirms it is gone.
linkedFolders.missingFiles_other: {{count}} files were not found on the last scan. They are kept until a second scan confirms they are gone.
linkedFolders.rescanDone: Rescanned: {{added}} new, {{updated}} changed, {{missing}} not found, {{removed}} removed from the index.
linkedFolders.rescanOffline: The folder could not be reached, so nothing was changed.
linkedFolders.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this folder? Its objects leave your library unless they have notes, favorites, or files from another source. Your files on disk are not touched.
linkedFolders.howToLink: To link a folder, use Import on the Library page, choose a folder on this server, and pick Link this folder.

libraryCleanup.title: Cleanup
libraryCleanup.description: See what takes up space in your library and clear out what you don't need.
libraryCleanup.subframesDescription: The raw FITS frames behind each stack. They are the largest files in the library.
libraryCleanup.none: No sub-frames are stored in your library.
libraryCleanup.note: Stacked images, thumbnails and previews are never touched. Files in linked folders are left where they are.
libraryCleanup.confirm: Permanently delete all {{count}} sub-frames ({{size}})? This cannot be undone. Stacked images are kept.
libraryCleanup.stale: {{count}} sub-frame records point to files that are no longer on disk. They are not counted above, and purging clears them out.

libraryHealth.title: Library health
libraryHealth.description: Find records that no longer match what is on disk.
libraryHealth.intro: Scans your library for missing files, objects whose folder is gone, and layout mismatches. Nothing is changed until you press a repair button.
libraryHealth.unreadable_one: 1 file or folder could not be checked, so it is not counted above and the repairs above are switched off. Check that the library drive is healthy, then scan again.
libraryHealth.unreadable_other: {{count}} files or folders could not be checked, so they are not counted above and the repairs above are switched off. Check that the library drive is healthy, then scan again.
libraryHealth.note: Repairs never delete image files. Objects whose folder is gone go to the trash and can be restored.

stale.title: Missing files
stale.detail: Records for files no longer on disk, across {{objects}} object(s).

processed.title: Processed images with no file
processed.detail: Gallery cards for processed images whose file is gone, across {{objects}} object(s).

missing.title: Objects with no folder
missing.detail: Objects still listed but whose folder is gone.

drift.title: Layout flag mismatch
drift.detail: Stored as flat, but the folder is organized by night. The same fix runs at every startup.

flat.title: Flat-layout objects
flat.detail: Files not yet sorted into per-night folders. Reorganizing moves files.
